<script>
        (function() {
            var processed = new WeakSet();

            function initSubmenuWidths() {
                if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return;

                var submenuWrps = document.querySelectorAll('.header2__menu-submenu-wrp');
                submenuWrps.forEach(function(wrp) {
                    if (processed.has(wrp)) return;
                    processed.add(wrp);

                    var toc = wrp.querySelector('.header2__menu-submenu-toc');
                    if (!toc) return;

                    var hasLevel3 = !toc.classList.contains('without-level3') && toc.querySelectorAll('.header2__menu-submenu').length > 0;

                    wrp.style.width = '270px';

                    var tocItems = wrp.querySelectorAll('.header2__menu-submenu-toc-item');
                    var hoveredItems = new Set();

                    tocItems.forEach(function(item) {
                        var submenu = item.querySelector('.header2__menu-submenu');
                        if (!submenu) return;

                        item.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                            hoveredItems.add(item);
                            wrp.style.width = '568px';
                        });

                        item.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                            hoveredItems.delete(item);
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                if (hoveredItems.size === 0) {
                                    wrp.style.width = '270px';
                                }
                            }, 50);
                        });
                    });

                    wrp.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                        hoveredItems.clear();
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            wrp.style.width = '270px';
                        }, 50);
                    });

                    var menuItem = wrp.closest('.header2__menu-item');
                    if (menuItem) {
                        var itemsWithLevel3 = new Set();
                        var hoveredLevel3Items = new Set();

                        tocItems.forEach(function(item) {
                            var submenu = item.querySelector('.header2__menu-submenu');
                            if (submenu) {
                                itemsWithLevel3.add(item);
                                var level3Items = submenu.querySelectorAll('.header2__menu-submenu2-item');
                                var level3ItemsCount = level3Items.length;

                                item.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                                    hoveredLevel3Items.add(item);

                                    setTimeout(function() {
                                        if (level3ItemsCount > 6) {
                                            var firstLevel3Item = level3Items[0];
                                            var lastLevel3Item = level3Items[level3ItemsCount - 1];

                                            if (firstLevel3Item && lastLevel3Item) {
                                                var firstRect = firstLevel3Item.getBoundingClientRect();
                                                var lastRect = lastLevel3Item.getBoundingClientRect();
                                                var submenuHeight = lastRect.bottom - firstRect.top;

                                                var paddingTop = 20;
                                                var paddingBottom = 20;
                                                var calculatedHeight = submenuHeight + paddingTop + paddingBottom + 20;

                                                if (calculatedHeight > 380) {
                                                    wrp.style.setProperty('height', calculatedHeight + 'px', 'important');
                                                    toc.style.setProperty('height', (calculatedHeight - paddingTop - paddingBottom) + 'px', 'important');
                                                } else {
                                                    wrp.style.removeProperty('height');
                                                    toc.style.removeProperty('height');
                                                }
                                            } else {
                                                var itemHeight = 44;
                                                var paddingTop = 20;
                                                var paddingBottom = 20;
                                                var rows = Math.ceil(level3ItemsCount / 2);
                                                var calculatedHeight = rows * itemHeight + paddingTop + paddingBottom + 20;

                                                if (calculatedHeight > 380) {
                                                    wrp.style.setProperty('height', calculatedHeight + 'px', 'important');
                                                    toc.style.setProperty('height', (calculatedHeight - paddingTop - paddingBottom) + 'px', 'important');
                                                } else {
                                                    wrp.style.removeProperty('height');
                                                    toc.style.removeProperty('height');
                                                }
                                            }
                                        } else {
                                            wrp.style.removeProperty('height');
                                            toc.style.removeProperty('height');
                                        }
                                    }, 10);
                                });

                                item.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                                    hoveredLevel3Items.delete(item);
                                    setTimeout(function() {
                                        if (hoveredLevel3Items.size === 0) {
                                            setAdaptiveHeight();
                                        }
                                    }, 50);
                                });
                            }
                        });

                        function setAdaptiveHeight() {
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                var itemsCount = tocItems.length;
                                var firstItem = tocItems[0];
                                var lastItem = tocItems[itemsCount - 1];

                                if (firstItem && lastItem) {
                                    var firstRect = firstItem.getBoundingClientRect();
                                    var lastRect = lastItem.getBoundingClientRect();
                                    var contentHeight = lastRect.bottom - firstRect.top;
                                    var paddingTop = 20;
                                    var paddingBottom = 20;
                                    var calculatedHeight = contentHeight + paddingTop + paddingBottom;

                                    wrp.style.setProperty('height', calculatedHeight + 'px', 'important');
                                    toc.style.setProperty('height', (calculatedHeight - paddingTop - paddingBottom) + 'px', 'important');
                                } else {
                                    var itemHeight = 44;
                                    var paddingTop = 20;
                                    var paddingBottom = 20;
                                    var calculatedHeight = itemsCount * itemHeight + paddingTop + paddingBottom;
                                    wrp.style.setProperty('height', calculatedHeight + 'px', 'important');
                                    toc.style.setProperty('height', (calculatedHeight - paddingTop - paddingBottom) + 'px', 'important');
                                }
                            }, 10);
                        }

                        menuItem.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                            if (hoveredLevel3Items.size === 0) {
                                setAdaptiveHeight();
                            }
                        });

                        menuItem.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                            hoveredLevel3Items.clear();
                            wrp.style.removeProperty('height');
                            toc.style.removeProperty('height');
                        });
                    }
                });
            }

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSubmenuWidths);
            } else {
                setTimeout(initSubmenuWidths, 0);
            }

            var observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
                initSubmenuWidths();
            });

            if (document.body) {
                observer.observe(document.body, {
                    childList: true,
                    subtree: true
                });
            } else {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                    observer.observe(document.body, {
                        childList: true,
                        subtree: true
                    });
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

            function onclick_header2__mobile_btn_menu(btn, event) {

                $('.header2__mobile-menu-wrp a').on('click', onclick_header2__mobile_menu_link);

            function onclick_header2__btn_close_mobile(btn, event) {
                if ($('.header2.header2--mobile-show-submenu').length) {
                    $('.header2').removeClass('header2--mobile-show-submenu');
                    $('.header2__menu-submenu--show-mobile').removeClass('header2__menu-submenu--show-mobile');
                    $('.header2__menu-submenu-toc-item').removeClass('focused');
                    return;
                }

                // надо закрыть левое меню
                $('.header2').removeClass('header2--mobile-show-menu');
                $('html').removeClass('no-scroll');
                $('.header2__menu-item').off('click', onclick_header2__menu_item);
                $('.header2__menu-submenu-toc-item').off('click', onclick_header2__menu_submenu_toc_item);
                $('.header2__middle-menu-item.with-submenu').off('click', onclick_header2__menu_submenu_toc_item);
                $('.header2__mobile-menu-wrp a').off('click', onclick_header2__mobile_menu_link);
            }

            function onclick_header2__mobile_menu_link(event) {
                if (window.innerWidth > 768)
                    return;
                if ($(event.target).closest('.header2__menu-submenu a, .header2__middle-menu-submenu a').length) {
                    $('.header2').removeClass('header2--mobile-show-submenu');
                    $('.header2__menu-submenu--show-mobile').removeClass('header2__menu-submenu--show-mobile').css('height', '');
                    $('.header2__menu-submenu-toc-item').removeClass('focused');
                    $('.header2__middle-menu-item.with-submenu').removeClass('focused');
                }
            }

            function onclick_header2__menu_item(event) {
                if (event.target.className.indexOf('header2__menu-item-link-text') > -1)
                    return;
                if (event.target.className.indexOf('header2__menu-submenu-toc-link-text') > -1)
                    return;
                if (event.target.classList.contains('header2__menu-submenu2-item-link')) // lv3
                    return;
                if (event.target.parentNode.classList.contains('without-submenu')) // lv2
                    return;
                if (event.target.parentNode.classList.contains('with_submenu') == false) // lv1
                    return;

                var $trg = $(event.target.nodeName == 'A' ? event.target.parentNode : event.target);
                if ($trg.hasClass('focused'))
                    $trg.removeClass('focused');
                else
                    $trg.addClass('focused');
                event.stopPropagation();
                event.preventDefault();
                return false;
            }

            function onclick_header2__menu_submenu_toc_item(event) {
                if ($(event.target).closest('.header2__menu-submenu a, .header2__middle-menu-submenu a').length)
                    return;
                var $trg = $(event.target).closest('.header2__menu-submenu-toc-item');
                if (!$trg.length) $trg = $(event.target.nodeName == 'A' ? event.target.parentNode : event.target);
                var $submenu = $trg.find('.header2__menu-submenu,.header2__middle-menu-submenu');

                if ($trg.hasClass('focused')) {
                    $trg.removeClass('focused');
                    if ($submenu.length) {
                        $submenu.removeClass('header2__menu-submenu--show-mobile').css('height', '');
                        if (!$('.header2__menu-submenu-toc-item.focused').length && !$('.header2__menu-submenu--show-mobile').length)
                            $('.header2').removeClass('header2--mobile-show-submenu');
                    }
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    event.preventDefault();
                    return false;
                }

                if ($submenu.length) {
                    $trg.addClass('focused');
                    $submenu
                        .addClass('header2__menu-submenu--show-mobile')
                        .css('height', $('.header2').css('height'));
                    $('.header2').addClass('header2--mobile-show-submenu');

                    event.stopPropagation();
                    event.preventDefault();
                    return false;
                }
                $trg.addClass('focused');
            }
        </script>

  // --- Основная функция расчёта ---
  function normalizeSizeValue(input, fallback) {
    var value = Number(input && input.value ? input.value : fallback);

    if (value > 4000) value = 4000;
    if (input) input.value = Math.round(value);

  function updateSizeFlagPosition(slider, flagEl) {
    if (!slider || !flagEl) return;
    var min = Number(slider.min);
    var max = Number(slider.max);
    var value = Number(slider.value);
    var percent = max === min ? 0 : ((value - min) / (max - min)) * 100;
    var safePercent = Math.min(92, Math.max(8, percent));
    flagEl.parentElement.style.left = safePercent + '%';

  function paintSliderProgress(slider) {

  // --- Обновление цены ---
  var calcAnimatedPriceCurrent = 0;
  var calcAnimatedPriceTimer = null;

  function renderWindowPrice(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'number') {
      totalWindowPrice.innerHTML = value;
      if (totalWindowPriceOld) totalWindowPriceOld.innerHTML = value;
      return;
    }
    var formattedCurrent = value.toFixed(0).replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ");
    var oldPriceValue = Math.round(value * 1.15);
    var formattedOld = oldPriceValue.toFixed(0).replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ");
    totalWindowPrice.innerHTML = formattedCurrent;
    if (totalWindowPriceOld) totalWindowPriceOld.innerHTML = formattedOld;

  function animateWindowPrice(targetValue) {
    if (!useMosquitoCalcMechanicsForPlasticWindows || typeof targetValue !== 'number') {
      calcAnimatedPriceCurrent = typeof targetValue === 'number' ? targetValue : calcAnimatedPriceCurrent;
      renderWindowPrice(targetValue);
      return;
    }

    if (calcAnimatedPriceTimer) {
      clearInterval(calcAnimatedPriceTimer);
      calcAnimatedPriceTimer = null;
    }

    var start = calcAnimatedPriceCurrent;
    var intv = 25;
    var msecs = 500;
    var ticks = msecs / intv;
    var totalTicks = ticks;
    var deltas = (targetValue - start) / ticks;

    calcAnimatedPriceTimer = setInterval(function() {
      if (ticks <= 0) {
        clearInterval(calcAnimatedPriceTimer);
        calcAnimatedPriceTimer = null;
        calcAnimatedPriceCurrent = targetValue;
        renderWindowPrice(targetValue);
        return;
      }

      var tickKoef = totalTicks - ticks;
      var nextPrice = start + tickKoef * deltas;
      renderWindowPrice(nextPrice);
      ticks--;
    }, intv);
  }

  function refreshPrice() {

    animateWindowPrice(price);
    onProfileEvent();

  function schedulePriceRefresh() {

  function persistCalcPopupPayload(calculatorType, params) {

  // --- Обработчики событий ---
  profileWindow.addEventListener('change', refreshPrice);

(function () {
	function isFs() {
		return !!(document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement);
	}

	function bindRdvWrap(wrap) {
		if (wrap.getAttribute('data-rdv-bound') === '1') {
			return;
		}
		wrap.setAttribute('data-rdv-bound', '1');
		var video = wrap.querySelector('.rdv-video__el');
		var btn = wrap.querySelector('.rdv-play');
		if (!video || !btn) {
			return;
		}

		var rdvFsSession = false;

		function hidePlay() {
			btn.classList.add('rdv-play--hidden');
		}
		function showPlay() {
			btn.classList.remove('rdv-play--hidden');
		}

		function resetPreviewMode() {
			rdvFsSession = false;
			video.controls = false;
			video.pause();
			try {
				video.currentTime = 0;
			} catch (e) { /* silence */ }
			showPlay();
		}

		async function enterFullscreenPlay() {
			video.controls = true;
			hidePlay();

			var ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
			var isIos = /iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(ua);

			try {
				if (isIos && typeof video.webkitEnterFullscreen === 'function') {
					rdvFsSession = true;
					await video.play();
					video.webkitEnterFullscreen();
					return;
				}
				if (video.requestFullscreen) {
					rdvFsSession = true;
					await video.requestFullscreen();
					await video.play();
					return;
				}
				if (video.webkitRequestFullscreen) {
					rdvFsSession = true;
					video.webkitRequestFullscreen();
					await video.play();
					return;
				}
				if (wrap.requestFullscreen) {
					rdvFsSession = true;
					await wrap.requestFullscreen();
					await video.play();
					return;
				}
				if (wrap.webkitRequestFullscreen) {
					rdvFsSession = true;
					wrap.webkitRequestFullscreen();
					await video.play();
					return;
				}
				await video.play();
			} catch (e) {
				rdvFsSession = false;
				try {
					await video.play();
				} catch (e2) { /* silence */ }
			}
		}

		btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
			enterFullscreenPlay();
		});

		document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', function () {
			if (!isFs() && rdvFsSession) {
				resetPreviewMode();
			}
		});
		document.addEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange', function () {
			if (!isFs() && rdvFsSession) {
				resetPreviewMode();
			}
		});
		video.addEventListener('webkitendfullscreen', function () {
			if (rdvFsSession) {
				resetPreviewMode();
			}
		});
	}

	function initAllRdv() {
		document.querySelectorAll('.rdv-section .rdv-video').forEach(bindRdvWrap);
	}

	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initAllRdv);
	} else {
		initAllRdv();
	}
})();
</script>
<script>
var gis2_credit_calc = {

	// обновление бегунка суммы
	oninput_range_TotalSum: function(event)
	{
		var range_totalSumOfOrder = event.target;
		var input_totalSumOfOrder = this.elem(event, 'input[name=sum]');

		input_totalSumOfOrder.value = range_totalSumOfOrder.value.replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ");

		this.refreshTotalPrice(event);
	},

	// обновление поля суммы
	oninput_TotalSum: function(event)
	{
		var range_totalSumOfOrder = this.elem(event, 'input[name=sum_range]');

		// ограничения
		if (!event.target.value.match(/^[0-9 ]+$/))
			event.target.value = event.target.getAttribute('min').replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ");
		else if (event.target.value.replace(/ +/g, '')*1 > event.target.getAttribute('max')*1)
			event.target.value = event.target.getAttribute('max').replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ");

		// обновим ползунок
		range_totalSumOfOrder.value = event.target.value.replace(/ +/g, '')*1;

		// пересчитаем суммы
		this.refreshTotalPrice(event);
	},

	// обновление слайдера процента первоночального взноса
	oninput_range_FirstFeed: function(event)
	{
		var range_firstFeed = event.target;
		var input_firstFeed = this.elem(event, 'input[name=first_feed]');

		input_firstFeed.value = range_firstFeed.value;

		this.refreshTotalPrice(event);
	},

	// обновление процента Первоначального взноса
	oninput_FirstFeed: function(event)
	{
		var range_firstFeed = this.elem(event, 'input[name=first_feed_range]');
		var input_firstFeed = event.target;

		// ограничения
		if (!input_firstFeed.value.match(/^[0-9]{2,}$/))
			input_firstFeed.value = input_firstFeed.getAttribute('min');
		else if (input_firstFeed.value*1 > input_firstFeed.getAttribute('max')*1)
			input_firstFeed.value = input_firstFeed.getAttribute('max');

		// обновим ползунок
		range_firstFeed.value = input_firstFeed.value;

		// пересчитаем суммы
		this.refreshTotalPrice(event);
	},

	// семена срока рассрочки
	oninput_Period: function(event)
	{
		// пересчитаем суммы
		this.refreshTotalPrice(event);
	},

	oninput_Date: function(event)
	{
		// дата не может быть вчерашняя или ранее
		if ((new Date(event.target.value))*1 < (new Date(event.target.getAttribute('min')))*1)
			event.target.value = event.target.getAttribute('min');
		// что-то нето ввели
		if (isNaN((new Date(event.target.value))*1))
			event.target.value = event.target.getAttribute('min');

		// пересчитаем суммы
		this.refreshTotalPrice(event);
	},

	// Пересчёт конечных сум
	refreshTotalPrice: function(event) {
		var input_totalSumOfOrder =  this.elem(event, 'input[name=sum]');
		var input_firstFeed = this.elem(event, 'input[name=first_feed]');
		var totalSumOfOrder = input_totalSumOfOrder.value.replace(/ +/g, '')*1.0;

		// всего
		(this.elem(event, '.total-sum')||{}).innerHTML = totalSumOfOrder.toFixed(0).replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ") + ' ₽';

		var input_Date = this.elem(event, 'input[name=recv_date]');

		// сумма первого платежа
		this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-1pay').innerHTML =
			input_Date.value.replace(/^..(..)-(..)-(..)/, '$3.$2.$1') +
			', ' +
			(totalSumOfOrder*(input_firstFeed.value*0.01)).toFixed(0).replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ") +
			' ₽';

		var input_Period = this.elem(event, 'select[name=period]');
		switch(input_Period.selectedIndex)
		{
			default:
			// 2 месяца
			case 0:
				var now = new Date(input_Date.value),
					plus_1month = new Date(input_Date.value);
				plus_1month.setMonth(now.getMonth()+1);

				// сумма второго платежа
				this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-2pay').innerHTML =
					plus_1month.toISOString().replace(/..(..)-(..)-(..).*/, '$3.$2.$1') +
					', ' +
					(totalSumOfOrder - (totalSumOfOrder*(input_firstFeed.value*0.01))).toFixed(0).replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ") +
					' ₽';

				// 0 руб?
				if (totalSumOfOrder == Math.round(totalSumOfOrder*(input_firstFeed.value*0.01)))
					this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-2pay').style.display = 'none';
				else
					this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-2pay').style.display = 'block';

				// сумма третьего платежа - скроем
				this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-3pay').style.display = 'none';

				break;

			// 3 месяца
			case 1:
				var now = new Date(input_Date.value),
					plus_1month = new Date(input_Date.value),
					plus_2month = new Date(input_Date.value);
				plus_1month.setMonth(now.getMonth()+1);
				plus_2month.setMonth(now.getMonth()+2);

				// сумма второго платежа
				this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-2pay').innerHTML =
					plus_1month.toISOString().replace(/..(..)-(..)-(..).*/, '$3.$2.$1') +
					', ' +
					((totalSumOfOrder - (totalSumOfOrder*(input_firstFeed.value*0.01)))/2).toFixed(0).replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ") +
					' ₽';

				// сумма третьего платежа
				this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-3pay').innerHTML =
					plus_2month.toISOString().replace(/..(..)-(..)-(..).*/, '$3.$2.$1') +
					', ' +
					((totalSumOfOrder - (totalSumOfOrder*(input_firstFeed.value*0.01)))/2).toFixed(0).replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "$1 ") +
					' ₽';

				// 0 руб?
				if (totalSumOfOrder == Math.round(totalSumOfOrder*(input_firstFeed.value*0.01))) {
					this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-2pay').style.display = 'none';
					this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-3pay').style.display = 'none';
				}
				else {
					this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-2pay').style.display = 'block';
					this.elem(event, '.gis2-credit-calc__calc-right-3pay').style.display = 'block';
				}

				break;
		}
	},

	// поиск элемента формы
	elem: function(event, elem_selector) {
		for (var trg = event.target; trg.parentNode; trg = trg.parentNode)
			if (trg.parentNode.className.indexOf('gis2-credit-calc__calc-wrapper') > -1) {
				return elem_selector
					? trg.parentNode.querySelector(elem_selector)
					: trg.parentNode;
			}

		throw 'gis2-credit-calc__calc-wrapper - not found!';
	}
};

                                    function replaceQueryParam(url, param, value) {
                                        var explodedUrl = url.split('?');
                                        var baseUrl = explodedUrl[0] || '';
                                        var query = '?' + (explodedUrl[1] || '');
                                        var regex = new RegExp("([?;&])" + param + "[^&;]*[;&]?");
                                        var queryWithoutParameter = query.replace(regex, "$1").replace(/&$/, '');
                                        return baseUrl + (queryWithoutParameter.length > 2 ? queryWithoutParameter + '&' : '?') + (value ? param + "=" + value : '');
                                    }

                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

        const fullText = document.getElementById('ck-full-text');

        function hideBanner(cb) {
            if (banner.style.display === 'none') {
                cb?.();
                return;
            }
            gsap.to(banner, {
                duration: .35,
                y: 50,
                opacity: 0,
                ease: 'power2.inOut',
                onComplete() {
                    banner.style.display = 'none';
                    gsap.set(banner, {
                        y: 0,
                        opacity: 1
                    });
                    cb?.();
                },
            });
        }

        function showBanner() {
            banner.style.display = 'flex';
            gsap.from(banner, {
                duration: .4,
                y: 50,
                opacity: 0,
                ease: 'power2.out',
            });
        }

        openPrefsBtn.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            hideBanner(() => {
                settingsWrapper.style.display = 'flex';
                gsap.fromTo(
                    settingsWrapper, {
                        y: 200,
                        opacity: 0
                    }, {
                        duration: .45,
                        y: 0,
                        opacity: 1,
                        ease: 'power2.out'
                    },
                );
            });
        });

        backBtn.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            gsap.to(settingsWrapper, {
                duration: .45,
                y: 200,
                opacity: 0,
                ease: 'power2.in',
                onComplete() {
                    settingsWrapper.style.display = 'none';
                    showBanner();
                },
            });
        });

        function closeAll() {
            hideBanner();
            gsap.to(settingsWrapper, {
                duration: .3,
                opacity: 0,
                onComplete() {
                    settingsWrapper.style.display = 'none';
                },
            });
        }

        const setConsent = v => localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', JSON.stringify(v));
        const getSelected = () => ({
            statistic: document.getElementById('ck-stat')?.checked,
            preference: document.getElementById('ck-pref')?.checked,
            marketing: document.getElementById('ck-mark')?.checked,
        });

        acceptAllTop.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setConsent({
                all: true
            });
            closeAll();
        });
        acceptAllBot.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setConsent({
                all: true
            });
            closeAll();
        });
        rejectAll.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setConsent({

            });
            closeAll();
        });
        saveSelected.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setConsent(getSelected());

            });

            } catch (_) {

            }
        }, 1000);
    })();
